children: closed down 6.7% on Thursday after the coal company said former U.S. Senator Joe Manchin
from its board to devote more attention to his independent leadership council movement with his daughter; his last day on the board was September 4.
"Senator Manchin's insight, experience, and commitment to American energy, industry, and economic security added tremendous value to our work," Ramaco
CEO Randall Atkins said in response to the departure.
"While I am stepping away from the board, I remain a strong supporter of Ramaco and will do everything I can to help the company continue to succeed," Manchin said.
following a distribution of ~1M shares by major stakeholder Yorktown Energy Partners to its limited partners; shares have declined 36% YTD.
